title: GitHub main single-owner review policy mode

phases.objective: Allow a repository with exactly one eligible human collaborator to use exact-head self-attestation without weakening CI, while automatically reverting to independent approval whenever another eligible human collaborator exists, and govern the Production metadata migration required by that mode.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: pull request review plus repository policy plan/apply
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Single-owner mode plans zero GitHub-native approvals only when complete live collaborator and permission readback proves exactly one eligible human and requires the read-only Single Owner Review Gate on the exact head; independent approval resumes automatically otherwise.
steps: Read all effective collaborators with bounded pagination and resolve every collaborator permission.
Select single-owner mode only when collaborator and permission proof is complete and exactly one eligible human exists.
For a PR authored by that sole eligible human, require an exact-head COMMENTED owner attestation because GitHub rejects self-APPROVE.
Evaluate the gate in a read-only pull-request workflow whose native Actions job is named Single Owner Review Gate; do not create a Check Run through a write API.
Require that native status check in the managed main Ruleset and keep stale-review, thread-resolution, strict status checks, no bypass actors, non-fast-forward and direct-push blocking.
Reject explicit single_owner_mode when complete collaborator eligibility cannot be proven.
assertions: Sole eligible human with exact-head attestation passes.
Adding an eligible independent collaborator disables self-attestation mode and requires independent APPROVED review.
Partial collaborator or permission readback fails closed to independent approval mode.
Single-owner Ruleset uses native approval count zero only together with the required Single Owner Review Gate.
Independent mode still requires at least one GitHub-native approval.
The pull-request gate is read-only and does not request checks:write or invoke the Check Runs write API.
No bypass actors, force push, repository content mutation, secrets, Production mutation or provider action are introduced.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Readiness is checksum-bound and write-free, its no-secret evidence remains machine-verifiable after sanitization, Apply can be attempted exactly once only after separate migration authorization, and verification proves the migration ledger plus single-owner metadata without applying the live GitHub Ruleset.
steps: Pin the exact Production migration blob, checksum, statement count and source merge and prove Runtime parity with current Production.
Create a checksum-bound authorization capability envelope and execute dry-run with zero preflight risks; do not execute SQL during readiness.
Sanitize the readiness artifact while preserving the explicit safe boolean secrets_included=false and continuing to redact every other sensitive-key value.
Publish readiness to Issue 6612 only from a trusted workflow_run publisher after validating the exact source run, SHA and artifact.
Require the migration-specific Apply confirmation and the exact readiness marker before the single Apply invocation.
Never retry an Apply after transport ambiguity; reconcile through exact migration ledger and read-only metadata readback.
Prove Repository Policy Controller metadata is registered and live_github_policy_apply remains false; GitHub Ruleset Apply stays a separate capability and confirmation.
assertions: The rollout producer has contents: read only and cannot mutate Issue metadata.
The trusted publisher alone has issues: write and accepts only a successful exact-source readiness artifact.
The sanitizer preserves only the explicit safe evidence field secrets_included=false while all other sensitive-key values remain redacted.
The trusted publisher contract remains fail-closed and still requires summary.secrets_included === false.
The runner contains exactly one Apply invocation literal and records apply_retried=false.
The only direct DB operation is a SELECT metadata readback.
The migration-specific confirmation is distinct from APPLY_GITHUB_MAIN_REVIEW_POLICY.
No raw SQL Apply, provider mutation, Production ref mutation, force push, credential publication, external send or live GitHub policy mutation is introduced.
